parameters.name: Filters
parameters.description: The list of filter conditions used to filter chat configurations.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the filter condition.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the filter condition.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last API call.
